page_title: NotchMuse — Desktop & Menu Bar Lyrics for Mac

sources.entry: NotchMuse - Open-source synced lyrics for Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and Soda Music in the menu bar, beside the notch, or above the Dock. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Xiye88/NotchMuse) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: NotchMuse
summary.one_liner: NotchMuse is a free macOS app that shows synced song lyrics near the notch, above the Dock, or in the menu bar, working with Spotify, Apple Music and several Chinese music players.
use_cases: Follow song lyrics while working in other apps
Show synced lyrics beside the MacBook notch
Display lyrics in the macOS menu bar
Read lyrics for Spotify or Apple Music playback on a Mac
Show lyrics for NetEase Cloud Music or QQ Music on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: NotchMuse displays synced lyrics for the song currently playing on a Mac. It offers two display modes set in Settings: Notch Mode, which keeps lyrics near the notch or above the Dock, and Status Bar Mode, which shows lyrics in the macOS menu bar. It reads the selected player's current track and playback position through Automation permission, and can read the left-side menu bar layout with Accessibility permission. Users can customize the look with solid colors, gradients, and a background. The page says it does not read or upload audio, and track title and artist may be sent to third-party lyrics providers for matching.
notable: Open source, listed on the awesome-mac list with a GitHub repository
Shows lyrics beside the notch, above the Dock, or in the menu bar
Supports Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and Soda Music
No account or telemetry required by the app
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later and an Apple silicon Mac
Direct download is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so macOS may show a first-launch security prompt
Updates are manual for v0.8.1; the automatic update feed still offers v0.8.0
